inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL scalar expression applies LOG to a positive value, uses LOG with an explicit base, and nests LOG with EXP.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar projection containing LOG(8), LOG(2, 8), and LOG(EXP(2)). It isolates the natural-log evaluator, arbitrary-base form, and nested base-e round trip without the source variables or lesson statements.

fixture_notes: LOG(8) is the natural logarithm, LOG(2, 8) must return 3, and LOG(EXP(2)) must return approximately 2.
determinism_notes: The scalar literals are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT LOG(8) AS natural_log, LOG(2, 8) AS base_two_log, LOG(EXP(2)) AS exp_log_round_trip
